title: Native historical VIXEN witnesses need a drive-native staging route
body: Two queued builds of the exact wave checkout under the WSL worktree stalled in CMake configure for more than 1000 seconds; staging the same checkout under /mnt/c and running tools/vixen-native.sh with the documented native toolchain completed. The facade should provide an authorized, relocation-safe native historical-witness route so lanes do not hand-stage a second checkout.

title: Relocation-safe FetchContent caches for native lane witnesses
body: Copying the shared FetchContent cache wholesale into the drive-native checkout failed because CMakeCache.txt embedded the original /home/liory/.cache/vixen-fetchcontent-cache path; copying only the *-src trees into a fresh cache directory worked. The native witness tooling should materialize or validate relocation-safe source caches instead of requiring manual cache surgery.

title: Native staging should resolve UNDERTOW_ROOT without a manual provider override
body: The drive-native historical checkout could not derive the sibling Undertow checkout and configure stopped with a missing transpiled/textshader/Text.g.h and text.g.glsl diagnostic; exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow allowed the build. vixen-native should carry the documented provider root into native staging or resolve it from the lane configuration.

title: Historical native GPU selectors must stop before legacy lookdev fallback
body: On the pre-c408 tree, invoking tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat with the focused -R HeadlessStarfieldGraph selector fell through to the default lookdev/HUD phase because the selector route lacked a terminating goto; it then failed on missing later executables. The documented selector should be structurally tested or the native wrapper should invoke ctest directly for historical trees.

title: Native focused GPU witnesses need a bounded queue-admission fallback
body: The queued native CaptureFirst submitted as resource=gpu remained head-blocked for over 12 minutes with no payload start and had to be canceled; rerunning the same tools/vixen-native.sh CTest through the live queue as resource=test admitted and passed, with a head-blocked diagnostic. The native witness contract should expose a bounded, auditable resource route rather than requiring a lane to change resource class manually.

title: New native lane checkouts should inherit pinned toolchain provisioning
body: The repaired lane checkout had no project-local Ninja or ccache, so the queued native build had to download Ninja 1.13.1 and ccache before compiling. The lane bootstrap should materialize or share the pinned native toolchain before the witness step, with the provisioning state visible to the queue.

title: Native lane sync should recover a rewritten committed tip
body: After amending the committed repair, tools/vixen-native.sh sync refused the native witness checkout because it had the prior lane tip and could no longer fast-forward; detaching the staging checkout explicitly at the amended SHA was required before the queued build. The sync route should detect a rewritten lane tip and perform a safe exact-tip materialization for witness checkouts.
